results.title: UI Verify vs Applitools: a self-serve alternative · UI Verify
results.content:
Applitools is the heavier tool you choose on purpose: a tunable perceptual match engine (strict, layout, content match levels per checkpoint), the Ultrafast Grid rendering across browsers including Edge and mobile devices, Autonomous test generation, accessibility and Figma design-comparison tooling, and on-prem or private-cloud deployment for a security team that requires it. A large organization standardizing on one vendor for all of that is well served. UI Verify is the better fit when you [...] Applitools’ Visual AI works at the detection step: it decides whether two screenshots look meaningfully different, suppressing pixel noise. UI Verify’s AI judge works a layer up, at the review step: it reads your pull request’s intent and asks whether the change was the point of the PR, then labels it an intended change, a regression, or a flake, with its reasoning, and a regression holds the merge. One decides what changed. The other decides what to do about it. [...] Published plans and per-snapshot rates at every tier, so you can price it yourself. Applitools publishes only an entry Starter, then you talk to sales.

results.title: Ubiquiti Help Center
results.content:
1.   Sign in to account.ui.com.
2.   Go to Security and click Click here to make changes in Security settings.
3.   Enter your password to unlock security settings and click Unlock.
4.   Click Add New Method and select UI Verify.
5.   Open your UniFi Verify app and click the upper-right + icon.
6.   Tap UI Account and tap Scan QR Code. [...] 7.   Scan the QR code displayed on your account.ui.com's security page, and then UniFi Verify will be added as an MFA method for your UI Account. When attempting to sign in to your UI Account, first enter your password, then open the UniFi Verify app and input the 6-digit code shown in the app. [...] 2.   Open your Verify app. 
    1.   Tap the upper-right + icon and select UID Enterprise Account_._
    2.   Tap Enter Secret Key, enter the secret key shown on your UID Enterprise page, and tapContinue.
    3.   Enter your app name (e.g., your workspace domain) and account name (e.g., albert@ui.com).
    4.   TapSave.

3.   Return to your UID Enterprise page.
